baseJson.description:
Json representation of the {@link GenaiCore.DynamicPy.Base} instance that the engine uses.

To persist this in package metadata, place it in a `data/GenaiCore.DynamicPy.Base/{{ baseInstanceId }}.json` file within your package.
To simply persist it in an app, use `GenaiCore.DynamicPy.Base.make({{ baseJson }}).upsert()`.

**NOTE** the file pointed to by the {@link GenaiCore.DynamicPy.Base#pySrc} must be accessible in the new app.

deploymentJson.description:
Json representation of the {@link GenaiCore.TypeProxyEngine.Deployment} that the engine uses.

To persist this in package metadata, place it in a `config/GenaiCore.TypeProxyEngine.Deployment/{{ engineName }}.json` file within your package.
To simply persist it in an app, use `GenaiCore.TypeProxyEngine.Deployment.make({{ deploymentJson }}).setConfig()`.

threadPoolConfigJson.description:
Json representation of the {@link App.Node.ThreadPool.Config} that the engine uses.

To persist this in package metadata, place it in a `config/App.Node.ThreadPool.Config/{{ engineName }}.json` file within your package.
To simply persist it in an app, use `App.Node.ThreadPool.Config.make({{ threadPoolConfigJson }}).setConfig()`.
